Name: MobileKeyboardBridge
Author: BabyQ01
Description:
Android 键盘支持
[list]
[*]点击 MOD 文本输入框时调用 Android 键盘。[/*]
[*]自动识别已经适配 Android 键盘的输入框。[/*]
[/list]触屏翻页按钮
[list]
[*]在支持滚轮或方向键操作的 MOD 菜单中显示上下箭头。[/*]
[*]点击箭头会模拟鼠标滚轮，实现向上、向下翻页。[/*]
[*]长按箭头可连续滚动。[/*]
[/list]可在 GMCM 中调整：
[list]
[*]显示或隐藏翻页按钮[/*]
[*]箭头大小[/*]
[*]水平位置[/*]
[*]垂直位置[/*]
[*]单次翻页幅度[/*]
[/list]按键绑定总览
在 Generic Mod Config Menu 中提供两个独立页面：
[list]
[*][b]按键绑定文本总览[/b]：以文字形式显示按键、配置项目及对应 MOD。[/*]
[*][b]键盘布局与快捷键编辑[/b]：按照电脑键盘布局显示全部按键。[/*]
[/list]键盘图中：
[list]
[*]红色表示按键已被绑定。[/*]
[*]绿色表示按键尚未绑定。[/*]
[*]支持查看使用该按键的 MOD。[/*]
[*]支持快捷编辑修改绑定。[/*]
[/list]
[heading]安装方法[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]安装适用于当前游戏版本的 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]解压 MobileKeyboardBridge 文件夹。[/*]
[*]将文件夹放入游戏的 files/Mods 目录。[/*]
[*]启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]如需使用图形化配置和按键总览，请同时安装 Generic Mod Config Menu (5098)。

[heading]兼容性
[size=3]最低 SMAPI 版本：4.0.0[/size]
[size=3]面向《星露谷物语》1.6.x
专为Android设备设计，但其中按键冲突查询功能PC设备可选择使用！！[/size][/heading]

如有问题可发Post 

抖音：@潇湘淋

Android keyboard support
[list]
[*]Call the Android keyboard when clicking the MOD text input box.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Automatically identify the input box that has been adapted to the Android keyboard.[/*]
[/list]Touch screen page turning button
[list]
[*]Displays the up and down arrows in the MOD menu that supports the operation of the scroll wheel or arrow keys.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Clicking the arrow will simulate the mouse wheel to turn pages up and down.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Long press the arrow to scroll continuously.[/*]
[/list]Can be adjusted in GMCM:
[list]
[*]Show or hide the Page Turn button.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Arrow size[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]level position[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]vertical position[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Single page turning amplitude[/*]
[/list]Key binding overview
Two separate pages are provided in the Generic Mod Config Menu:
[list]
[*]Overview of key binding text: display keys, configuration items and corresponding MOD in text form.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Keyboard layout and shortcut key editing: display all keys according to the computer keyboard layout.[/*]
[/list]In the keyboard diagram:
[list]
[*]Red indicates that the key has been bound.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Green indicates that the key has not been bound.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Support to view the MOD using this button.[/*]
[/list]Support quick editing and binding modification.
[size=4]method of erection[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI for the current game version.[/*]
[*]Unzip the MobileKeyboardBridge folder[/*]
[*]Put the folder into the files/Mods directory of the game.[/*]
[*]Start the game.[/*]
[/list]To use graphical configuration and key overview, please install Generic Mod Config Menu (5098) at the same time.

[b][size=4]compatibility[/size][/b]
Minimum SMAPI version: 4.0.0
Facing "Tale of Stardew Valley" 1.6.x
Specially designed for Android devices, but PC devices with key conflict query function can choose to use! !
Post if you have any questions.

Manifest.Name: Mobile Keyboard Bridge
Manifest.Description: Adds conflict-safe Android and Stardew on-screen keyboard input, configurable scroll arrows, compatibility adapters, and a standalone GMCM keyboard map/editor.
Manifest.Author: BabyQ & @抖音潇湘淋
